content:
Here are a few options for your LinkedIn post, ranging in tone slightly. Choose the one that best fits your personal style!

---

**Option 1: Enthusiastic and Direct**

Thrilled and honored to announce that I've been appointed to the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**!

My journey with CDS Hooks began back in 2017, and I've been consistently impressed by its power to transform clinical decision support. I'm incredibly excited to contribute to the continued development and evolution of this vital standard.

If you're already leveraging CDS Hooks in your work, please share your implementation and inspire others by adding it to the **CDS Hooks Availability Wiki**: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)

For those new to CDS Hooks or looking to implement it, I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate the process and unlock its full potential. Let's build a more intelligent healthcare ecosystem together!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #FHIR #EHR #HealthcareInnovation #FreelanceConsultant

---

**Option 2: Reflective and Forward-Looking**

It's a privilege to share that I've joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**. My involvement with the CDS Hooks standard dates back to 2017, and I've witnessed firsthand its significant impact on how we deliver timely, context-aware clinical decision support.

I'm deeply excited by this opportunity to contribute more formally to guiding the future of CDS Hooks and helping to advance its adoption and capabilities.

If your organization is already harnessing the power of CDS Hooks, I encourage you to add your implementation to our growing list on the **CDS Hooks Availability Wiki**: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)

For those exploring CDS Hooks implementation, I'm available as a freelance consultant to provide expertise and support. Reach out if you'd like to discuss how CDS Hooks can benefit your workflows.

#CDSHooks #DigitalHealth #HealthcareTechnology #Standards #Interoperability #EHRIntegration #HealthTech #Consulting

---

**Option 3: Concise and Action-Oriented**

Big news! I'm honored to join the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**. Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm eager to contribute to its continued growth and innovation.

Are you using CDS Hooks? Please add your implementation to the **CDS Hooks Availability Wiki**: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)

Not yet implementing CDS Hooks? I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you get started. Let's connect and explore the possibilities!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #EHR #Healthcare #Consultant

---

**Remember to:**

*   **Add a relevant image or GIF** to make your post more engaging (e.g., a picture of the CDS Hooks logo, a diagram related to CDS Hooks, or even a professional headshot).
*   **Tag any relevant organizations or individuals** if appropriate (e.g., if your company uses CDS Hooks or if you want to tag key figures in the CDS Hooks community).
*   **Engage with comments** you receive on your post.

Congratulations on this fantastic achievement!
